unit: pp of win probability per game vs the period's average tier-1 player; lane = draft+side WP -> WP@15, late = WP@15 -> result
method: per period (a season, or one league's split window): box-score prior (matchup-adjusted lane differences at 15; post-15 box score) x role weights + ridge plus-minus on that period's games only

words.tower: share of team damage to towers
words.g25: gold lead gained 20->25 min vs lane opponent
